To configure this module, you need to:

#. Go to *Accounting > Accounting > Fiscal Year Closings*.
#. Create or edit a fiscal year closing or a template.
#. In the **Moves configuration** section, edit a configuration line.
#. Locate the **Accounts mapping** section.
#. Click the **"Generate Range"** button to open the wizard.
#. Once the lines are generated by the wizard, save the configuration.
